args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (unhealthy in all regions, error rate 18%). Rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc had only been healthy in staging). After rollback, service reports healthy with error rate 0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened incident INC-0001 for it, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.3.1-rc was newer, but it was only ever healthy in staging, so I skipped it.
- **Result:** After the rollback, all three regions are on v2.3.0 and healthy, with the error rate down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 is a SEV2 for checkout-api. It records the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, the recovery, and a follow-up to find out why v2.3.1 failed before anyone redeploys it.
